title: Anniversary Review Requirement and Amount Requested - C&I Security
content:
> Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts: anniversary security review of a contract.

1. **Contracts reviewed.** The review applies to a contract in active status whose next anniversary of the service start date falls within 30 calendar days after the handling date.
2. **Review window.** The review window is the twelve months before the handling date, counted by the posted date of each bill line. A line falls in the twelve months before the handling date when it was posted on or before the handling date and fewer than twelve whole calendar months have passed from its posted date to the handling date, a month being complete on the same day of the month as the posted date.
3. **Requirement and amount requested.** The review requirement is the review months multiplied by the review's monthly exposure; the amount the review requests is the review requirement less the security deposits held on the contract (deposits posted less deposits refunded), rounded half up to the cent only at that last step, and nothing is requested when the deposits held already cover the requirement.
4. **Review months.** The review months are 2.
5. **Monthly exposure.** The review's monthly exposure is the kWh posted on the contract's supply lines in the review window multiplied by the structure's deposit reference rate in cents per kWh, divided by 100 and by 12 months per year.

## Worked through (hypothetical figures)

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| kWh posted on the contract's supply lines in the review window | 3600000 |
| deposit reference rate of a structure at 9.75 cents per kWh | 9.75 |
| monthly exposure: 3600000 multiplied by 9.75, divided by 100 and by 12 | $29250.00 |
| review requirement: 2 multiplied by 29250.00 | $58500.00 |
| deposits held on the contract: posted $40000.00, refunded $0.00 | $40000.00 |
| amount requested: 58500.00 less 40000.00 | $18500.00 |

With deposits held of $60000.00 instead, the deposits cover the requirement of $58500.00 and nothing is requested.

## Contracts reviewed (hypothetical dates)

- Service start date 20 October 2021, handling date 4 October 2026: the next anniversary, 20 October 2026, falls 16 days after the handling date, within 30 days, so an active contract is reviewed.
- Same contract, handling date 15 September 2026: the anniversary falls 35 days later, outside the 30 days.
